messages.content: When you say the identity token must be invalidated what do you mean exactly are you saying that when a run completes will no longer be able to use the new agent manager end point to get information about that agent? If so, I don’t know if that’s correct that doesn’t seem right to me like I feel like you should still be able to get information about that agent unless you have a good reason could you just like clarify what what you mean here and if you if you think the current direction that the decision is implying is correct?
